description: Whether the employee acknowledged customer emotions, used empathic language, and avoided cold or mechanical tone.

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Multiple, contextually-appropriate empathy expressions; explicit acknowledgement of feelings; warm, non-mechanical tone throughout.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: At least one explicit empathy expression and overall warm tone, with minor lapses.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Cold, mechanical, or dismissive tone; missing acknowledgement of clearly-expressed customer emotions; matched any forbidden_behavior.
